title: Detailed Inspection of the Fwd Cargo Door Surround Frames C36 to C44
abstract: Repeat detailed visual and eddy current inspection of the forward cargo door surround frames between stations C36 and C44, with the reporting rules for an indication at the lower corner radius.

sections.purpose: This task gives the repeat inspection of the forward cargo door surround frames between stations C36 and C44, with particular attention to the lower forward corner of the door cut-out.
sections.job_setup_note: The compartment must be empty and the lower shell lining must be out between the two end frames. Clean the frame surfaces before the visual inspection; a light film of hydraulic mist or of cargo dust will hide a tight crack. The eddy current inspection must be done by a qualified operator with a calibrated set and a reference block for the frame material. Allow time for the reporting step: an indication at the corner radius has to be reported before the aircraft moves.
sections.procedure: 1. Make sure that the compartment is empty and the cargo loading system is de-energised. 2. Remove the lower shell lining panels between frame stations C36 and C44 in zones 113 and 115. 3. Clean the frame surfaces and the doubler edges. 4. Do a detailed visual inspection of the frame doubler D5321117326151 at each station. 5. Do a detailed visual inspection of the lower web D5321117734118 with attention to the fastener rows nearest the cut-out. 6. Do a detailed visual inspection of the lower corner radius of the door cut-out. CAUTION: DO NOT USE A SCRIBE OR ANY SHARP TOOL TO FOLLOW AN INDICATION. A SCRIBE MARK BECOMES A NEW CRACK STARTER. 7. Do an eddy current inspection of the corner radius over the length given in the illustration. 8. Do an eddy current inspection of the two fastener rows on each side of the corner. 9. Record every indication with its position relative to the frame station and the stringer. WARNING: DO NOT RETURN THE AIRCRAFT TO SERVICE WITH AN UNREPORTED INDICATION AT THE CORNER RADIUS. 10. Report any indication to the operator engineering organisation for disposition. 11. Install the lining panels.
sections.close_out: Record the inspection result, the equipment serial numbers and the operator qualification on the aircraft work card. Where no indication is found, reset the repeat interval in the maintenance programme. Where an indication is found, keep the lining out until the disposition is received. Confirm that the cargo loading system is restored before the compartment is released.

type_data.effectivity_note: Pre MOD-160142 aircraft: repeat interval 3 000 flight cycles. Post MOD-160142 aircraft: the interval is set by the operator maintenance programme.

safety_precautions: Put the warning notices in position at the loading panel.
Use only a calibrated eddy current set.

sections.purpose: This task gives the repeat inspection of the forward cargo door surround frames between stations C36 and C44 on the passenger aircraft, with particular attention to the lower forward corner of the door cut-out. It does not cover the main deck cargo door opening of the freighter, which is a different cut-out with its own substantiation and its own inspection.
sections.job_setup_note: Confirm the opening before you start. This task is written for the forward cargo door cut-out only. The main deck cargo door opening introduced by MOD-160560 shares the chapter, the fastener standard and much of the wording of this task, and the aircraft type effectivity above does not by itself exclude it; the crack growth substantiation behind the intervals given here was never run for that opening and does not transfer to it.
